_about: Which WebinarJam export column feeds each field. ASSUMPTION: names are taken from WebinarJam's registrant export as we expect it (Registrants or Attendees export of one session), not from a real export yet. On the first real export, open its header row and put the exact names first in each list. Matching ignores case and extra spaces. A field with no matching column is treated as missing.
_colon_format: How a two-part time like 1:05 is read: h:mm (65 minutes, the default) or m:ss (1 minute 5 seconds). Three parts are always h:mm:ss. Check one known value in the first real export.
